name: uncver-ollama-qwen3-0.6b-ai
description: AI router on Redis stream with embedded Ollama (qwen3:0.6b) — full tool calling, network-aware
author: uncver

run.command: podman run -d --name uncver-ollama-qwen3-0.6b-ai --network uncver-network -v ollama-models:/root/.ollama -e REDIS_HOST=uncver-redis-stream -e REDIS_PORT=6379 -e SHARED_STREAM=uncver:ai:router -e OLLAMA_MODEL=qwen3:0.6b docker.io/uncoverthefuture/ollama-qwen3-0.6b-ai:latest
